rules.statement: A discretion under S-770 of the Civil Procedure Code is a very wide one and should be exercised cautiously.
rules.supporting_quote: On the other hand it is needless to stress that the discretion given under S - 770 is a very wide one and same has to be exercised cautiously which being a power expressly and plainly conferred on the Judge who hears the appeal.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 770 of the Civil Procedure Code
